text: わしの　マゴが　でてきて　おしえて　くれるん　だから　とうぜん　じゃな！

structure.jp: わしの　マゴが　でてきて
おしえて　くれるん　だから

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a verb plus くれる says someone does the thing as a kindness to the speaker or his side. おしえて　くれる = 'he teaches it for us'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a verb plus くる says the action moves toward where the speaker is looking. Here it is in the て-form again to link to the next action: でてきて = 'he comes out and'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'it is', typical of elderly characters in stories. とうぜん　じゃな = 'it's only natural, eh'.
